title: Easel
summary: E'ASEL, noun The frame on which painters place their canvas. Easel-pieces, among painters, are the smaller pieces, either portraits or landscapes, which are painted on the easel as distinguished from

inlines.v: E'ASEL, noun The frame on which painters place their canvas. Easel-pieces, among painters, are the smaller pieces, either portraits or landscapes, which are painted on the easel as distinguished from those which are drawn on walls, ceilings, etc.
